zap_actions.definition: Number of ZAP action groups reported by Stacker News itemGrowth.
zap_actions.caveat: The public aggregate does not establish that every zap action settled as a real Lightning payment.

zap_sats.definition: Gross zap-denominated value reported for ZAP by Stacker News spendingGrowth.
zap_sats.caveat: The aggregate may include activity involving Cowboy Credits.

daily_unique_zappers.definition: Distinct users associated with ZAP activity in one daily aggregation bucket.
daily_unique_zappers.caveat: Do not sum daily values to claim a weekly distinct-user count.

daily_unique_spenders.definition: Distinct users across tracked paid-action types in one daily aggregation bucket.
daily_unique_spenders.caveat: Do not sum daily values to claim a weekly distinct-user count.

tracked_paid_actions.definition: Sum of action-group counts for all pay-in types returned by itemGrowth after the API's exclusions.
tracked_paid_actions.caveat: This is scoped to the action types included by the public growth resolver.

content_items_created.definition: ITEM_CREATE action groups reported by Stacker News itemGrowth.
content_items_created.avoid_language: independently verified distinct posts and comments
content_items_created.caveat: Use as a content-activity proxy unless the upstream semantics are separately verified.

seconds_per_zap.definition: Seconds in the observed period divided by zap actions.
seconds_per_zap.caveat: This is an average interval, not a claim that actions occur at regular spacing.

average_zap_sats.definition: Zap-denominated sats divided by zap actions.
average_zap_sats.caveat: This is a ratio of public aggregate values and does not prove Lightning settlement.

zaps_per_100_content_items.definition: 100 times zap actions divided by ITEM_CREATE action groups.
zaps_per_100_content_items.caveat: The denominator is the ITEM_CREATE action-group count, used as a content-activity proxy.

reward_pool_sats.definition: Reward-pool value shown on the historical Stacker News rewards page for the reward date.
reward_pool_sats.caveat: The activity funding the pool occurred on the preceding America/Chicago calendar day. This may differ slightly from reward_distributed_sats.

reward_distributed_sats.definition: Custodial SN reward sats credited through REWARD payouts on the reward date, as reported by stackingGrowth.
reward_distributed_sats.caveat: The public aggregate does not establish Lightning settlement. It can be lower than the source-funded reward pool because it measures the resulting payouts.

daily_unique_reward_recipients.definition: Distinct SN users receiving a REWARD payout in one daily aggregation bucket.
daily_unique_reward_recipients.caveat: Do not sum daily recipient counts to claim a weekly distinct-user count.

reward_sats_per_recipient_day.definition: Reward sats in a period divided by the sum of daily unique reward-recipient counts.
reward_sats_per_recipient_day.caveat: This is a mean over recipient-days and does not describe the payout distribution or deduplicate users across days.

reward_source_share_pct.definition: A pay-in type's contribution to the reward pool divided by all recorded reward-pool sources for the period.
reward_source_share_pct.caveat: BOOST means only the portion assigned to rewards, not gross boost spending. Source values are supplied by the API in millisats.

global_caveats: Never describe zap_actions as Lightning transactions without separate settlement data.
Never sum daily_unique_zappers to obtain weekly distinct zappers.
Treat API observations as public aggregates, not independently audited figures.
reward_caveats: Reward dates are payout dates; reward-source activity occurred on the preceding America/Chicago calendar day.
Reward payouts are custodial SN reward sats and must not be described as confirmed Lightning payments.
reward_pool_sats measures the source-funded pool shown by the historical rewards page; reward_distributed_sats measures REWARD payouts actually credited and can be slightly lower.
Do not sum daily_unique_reward_recipients to obtain weekly distinct recipients; use recipient-days.
Reward source values are stored in raw millisats. BOOST represents only the reward-pool share of boosts.
Treat public reward aggregates as unaudited and allow a one-sat cross-endpoint rounding difference.
